name: hope
description: Align before implementation and preserve the agreement, sweep maintenance, improve completed work, challenge it with evidence, understand pull requests, and improve writing. Requires Node.js 22 or newer.

interface.shortDescription: Practical ways for people and AI to work better together
interface.longDescription: Align finds important misunderstandings before implementation and preserves the agreement as an HTML brief. Sweep inspects a codebase and returns a read-only maintenance plan. Polish independently reviews and improves completed work while preserving settled behavior and meaning. Toxic Review challenges work with evidence and clear priorities. Diff explains code changes so you can decide. Write improves language without changing its meaning.
defaultPrompt: Use $hope:align to build a shared understanding before implementation.
Use $hope:polish to simplify the current completed change without changing behavior.
Use $hope:diff to explain the current pull request.
